description: Reading the real FNIRSI 2C53T through «stock-link», the USB HID link a patch adds to its factory firmware (local plugin plugins/fnirsi): list the instruments, open the first one, send it the identification and subscription requests, read the reports it streams, close it. Only USB 1209:0001 named «2C53T stock-link» is ever listed or opened; the page never chooses a device or a path, and the link's memory-read request is never sent. Desktop: hidapi; Android: android.hardware.usb with the system's permission dialog.
